## Summary

Describe the problem and the change. Link related issues where appropriate.

## Validation

List commands actually run and their results. Note skipped checks and environment limitations. Add sanitized screenshots for visible UI changes.

## Compatibility and risk

Describe API, schema, dependency, platform, or security-boundary changes and any migration needs.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and follows CONTRIBUTING.md and AGENTS.md.
- [ ] Relevant regression tests and user-facing documentation are updated.
- [ ] No credentials, personal data, generated build outputs, or planning/report documents are included.
- [ ] This PR does not publicly disclose a vulnerability; security concerns are reported privately.
